criteria.text: Every account with administrative rights in scope is listed, human and machine, and the ones nobody can explain are removed
criteria.how: List them from every directory in scope and review the list with their owners.

criteria.text: Every privileged sign-in in scope uses strong multi-factor, with no exceptions list
criteria.how: Report a week of privileged sign-ins and show none skipped strong authentication.

criteria.text: A leaver loses every access in scope within a day, applications outside the directory included
criteria.how: Follow one leaver from the day they left to the last access removed, and time it.

criteria.text: A risky sign-in is blocked or challenged within minutes, and the team that acts on it is named
criteria.how: Simulate a risky sign-in and time it to the block or the challenge.

criteria.text: One access review of a sensitive application is done by its owner, and the rights nobody claims are removed
criteria.how: Run the review with the owner and count the rights removed.

readiness: The directories and identity providers in scope listed
Read access to sign-in and audit logs, and who approves it
A test account for the risky sign-in, agreed with security operations
The owner of one sensitive application, for the access review
Security, legal and procurement steps known
